parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `Playcut.stub` in `_Plant_PlaycutStub.swift` and `Talkset.stub` in `PlaylistStubs.swift` — carry `is_test: true`. Under the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is test-marked must be treated as a test-fixture and left untouched. Here both records are test fixtures living in the `PlaylistTesting` source set of the `Playlist` package, so lifting them into a shared generic function would couple test-stub semantics into production or shared infrastructure. No refactor is warranted.
